name: Abba Eban
contribution: A South African-born Israeli diplomat and politician, and a scholar of the Arabic and Hebrew languages.
legacy: He was the second ambassador to the United States and the first Permanent Representative of Israel to the United Nations

checks.lead: Abba Solomon Meir Eban ( ; Hebrew: אבא שלמה אבן [ˈ(ʔ)aba ˈ(ʔ)even]; born Aubrey Solomon Meir Eban; 2 February 1915 – 17 November 2002) was a South African-born Israeli diplomat and politician, and a scholar of the Arabic and Hebrew languages.
